Definition: Channiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hanniel = "favoured of God"; 1) son of Ephod and a prince of the tribe of Manasseh; 2) son of Ulla and a chief of the tribe of Asher; also 'Haniel'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
